Settings

Tune comfort first. Then tune the car.

Steering

Device rotation or On-screen steering; Left-handed controls; Tutorial steering help. Use RECALIBRATE in the race when your neutral position changes.

Sound

Sound enables game audio. DRIVE BY EAR enables spatial guidance and pace notes. Sound balance moves the emphasis between other sounds and that guidance. Music has its own controls.

Appearance and camera

System, Light and Dark themes set menu appearance. Drift camera follows the slide; Zoom responds to speed. Low graphics reduces rendering cost while retaining the track scenery.

Interface

Player marker and Color Cues help identify what is on screen. Scoring displays let you follow DRIFT and FLOW once available. Blank screen supports non-visual driving.

Records

RESET RIVALS applies to the selected track. Treat deletion as a deliberate fresh start. The wiki is a reference and does not change your game progress.
